{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Identify converted orders
converted_mask = df['converted'] == 1

# Identify email channel orders
email_mask = df['channel'] == 'email'

# Filter for converted email orders, excluding QA and refunded
filtered_email_df = df[converted_mask & email_mask & ~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Check final population size
final_count = len(filtered_email_df)

# Compute average revenue per converted email order
avg_revenue = filtered_email_df['revenue'].mean()

# Print results
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_mask.sum()}')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')
print(f'Converted email orders (before filtering): {converted_mask & email_mask}.sum()')
print(f'Final population size (converted email, not QA, not refunded): {final_count}')
print(f'Average revenue per converted email order: {avg_revenue:.2f}')"}
